question_text: A solid sphere at a certain temperature is completely immersed and floating in a liquid at $8^\circ C$ as shown in the figure. Volume expansivity of the liquid is $\gamma_l$, $\gamma_l > \gamma_s$. The entire sphere with the liquid is cooled down to $4^\circ C$ with volume expansivity $\gamma_s$.

options.option_text: The density of the sphere will be greater than the liquid after cooling.
The magnitude of the upthrust acting on the sphere will not change.
The following statements will be true the surface of the liquid after cooling.
only A, B and C are true.
